exposure: maternal obesity (BMI ⩾30 kg/m(2)) at 15 weeks' gestation
Low serum ferritin concentrations at birth
cohort: 413 mother-infant pairs from a population-based, longitudinal birth cohort in Ireland
finding: Maternal obesity and cesarean delivery were inversely associated with cord ferritin concentrations, while maternal smoking and being born small-for-gestational age were associated with an increased risk of low iron stores at birth.
mod_finding: Delivery by caesarean section was inversely associated with cord ferritin concentrations (-38.8 (-70.2, -7.4) μg/l, P=0.016).
